extracted.intended_audience: researchers, journalists, policymakers, and the public interested in press freedom rankings
extracted.subtask_description: A country-by-country press freedom index (RSF) listing each country's overall (global) score, component scores across several dimensions, rank out of 180, and change in position versus 2025. Used to compare press freedom performance across countries and regions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global score
rubrics_metrics.description: Global score / Index global — the overall national press freedom score presented as a numeric value (e.g., 92.72).

rubrics_metrics.name: Political score (Pol.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pol. / Score pol. — component score for the political dimension (labeled 'Pol.' in the table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic score (Eco.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Eco. / Score eco. — component score for the economic dimension (labeled 'Eco.' in the table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative score (Legis.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Legis. / Score legis. — component score for the legislative / legal framework dimension (labeled 'Legis.' in the table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Social score (Soc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Soc. / Score soc. — component score for the social environment dimension (labeled 'Soc.' in the table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Security score (Sécu.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sécu. / Score secu. — component score for the security dimension (labeled 'Sécu.' in the table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ranking position (Pos.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pos. — the country's rank in the index (position out of 180), shown alongside the global score (e.g., '1 / 180').

rubrics_metrics.name: Change in position vs. 2025 (Dif. Position 2025)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dif. Position 2025 — numeric indicator of how the country's ranking position has changed compared with 2025 (positive/negative integer).
